open_gaps.reason: actix.scope_route.v1 joins a scope prefix to routes only when the routes chain directly off `web::scope("/lit")` in the same expression. Routes registered under a scope via `.configure(fn)` or `.service(handler)` live in a cross-file target, so their scope prefix cannot flow into their effective_route_template in-file; actix.mount.v1 records the prefix at the scope site with mount_path/mount_target only.
open_gaps.required_closure: resolve the scope prefix to routes registered in a cross-file configure/service target, which is Miller's cross-file join responsibility per decision 0004; the extractor emits actix.mount.v1 and guesses no join

open_gaps.reason: actix.scope_route.v1 reads the scope prefix by walking the `.route` receiver chain to a base `web::scope(literal)` in the same expression. A scope bound to a variable first (`let s = web::scope("/api"); s.route(...)`) is cross-statement single-assignment tracing, which is not attempted this slice; such routes stay silent (M2) rather than emit a route with an unresolved prefix.
open_gaps.required_closure: add same-file single-assignment receiver tracing for scope variables (the axum receiver-poison model applied to `web::scope`), fixture-backed

open_gaps.reason: actix `web::resource("/x").route(web::get().to(h))` and guard-based route forms register routes without a `web::scope` prefix chain, so they are not covered by actix.scope_route.v1 (which anchors on scope prefixes) and stay silent.
open_gaps.required_closure: add a `web::resource`/route-guard collector emitting a resource route fact with the resource path and method-router verb, fixture-backed

open_gaps.reason: axum route params are recorded as brace captures (`{id}`, axum 0.8). axum 0.7 used `:id`; the extractor cannot know the crate version and does not version-sniff (design section 11), so a 0.7 `:id` template passes through to a correct normalized_route_template join key but its `:id` segment is not recorded in dynamic_segments.
open_gaps.required_closure: no closure without version detection, which is explicitly out of scope; a 0.7 `:id` template still joins correctly, only dynamic_segments under-reports its params

open_gaps.reason: Only reqwest (`reqwest::get("url")` / `client.get("url")`) ships in v2.8.0; hyper (low-level request-builder + body future) and ureq (blocking `ureq::get("url").call()`) each need their own detection shape and fixture.
open_gaps.required_closure: add per-library client collectors emitting http.client_request.v1 for hyper and ureq, each fixture-backed

open_gaps.reason: A `.nest("/api", sub_router)` mounts a sub-router whose routes are defined in another function/file, so the nest prefix cannot flow into those routes' effective_route_template in-file; axum.nest.v1 records the mount at its own site with mount_path/mount_target only.
open_gaps.required_closure: resolve nest prefix to sub-router routes, which is Miller's cross-file join responsibility per decision 0004; the extractor emits axum.nest.v1 and guesses no join

capability_gaps.reason: CSS @import directives resolve at extraction time and current relationship extraction emits direct edges. CSS has no forward-reference construct that would benefit from pending relationships.
CSS has no static type system. Custom property values are runtime strings; there is no type metadata to extract.

open_gaps.reason: PHP `#[Route('/x')]` attributes are a Symfony routing idiom, not Laravel; the Laravel lane detects only the Route facade DSL, so attribute-declared routes emit nothing.
open_gaps.required_closure: add a Symfony attribute-route collector emitting symfony.route.v1 from #[Route] attributes on controller methods/classes, with static-literal path guarding

open_gaps.reason: Only Guzzle (receiver->verb(url)) and the Laravel Http facade ship in v2.8.0; Symfony HttpClient (fluent request builder), the curl_* function family, and Guzzle's request('GET', url) two-argument form each need their own detection shape and fixture.
open_gaps.required_closure: add per-library client collectors emitting http.client_request.v1 for Symfony HttpClient, curl_*, and Guzzle request(verb, url), each fixture-backed

open_gaps.reason: A RouteServiceProvider `/api` group prefix is applied cross-file (in the provider, not the routes file), so it cannot flow into a route's effective_route_template in-file; route_template is therefore not guaranteed to be the absolute public path when such a prefix applies.
open_gaps.required_closure: resolve RouteServiceProvider group prefixes cross-file, which is Miller's join responsibility per decision 0004; the extractor emits laravel.route_prefix.v1 only for same-file prefixes

open_gaps.reason: Ktor server routing (the routing{} / route{} DSL) is a full seventh framework lane (collector, pattern id, registry spec, fixtures, contract docs); a safe restricted lexical gate is designed but out of v2.8.0 release scope.
open_gaps.required_closure: add a Ktor route collector emitting ktor.route.v1 for verb calls lexically contained in a routing{}/route{} lambda with a static string_literal first arg (Braces flavor), per design section 4.6

open_gaps.reason: The RouterFunction / coRouter functional DSL nests routes via nest()/path() closures that are not single-assignment same-file; annotation routing is the shipped Kotlin+Spring claim.
open_gaps.required_closure: add a lexical-containment collector for coRouter/RouterFunction nesting once a same-file nesting model is designed

open_gaps.reason: Only the Ktor client (receiver.verb(url) shape) ships in v2.8.0; OkHttp (fluent Request.Builder().url() chain), Retrofit (annotation-based), WebClient, and RestTemplate each need their own detection shape and fixture and are deferred.
open_gaps.required_closure: add per-library client collectors emitting http.client_request.v1 for OkHttp/Retrofit/WebClient/RestTemplate, each fixture-backed

open_gaps.reason: The Phoenix lane emits route/resource/forward facts only; the `pipe_through`, `live` (LiveView), `socket`, and `channel` router macros carry no request→handler HTTP boundary path literal in the same shape, so they emit nothing.
open_gaps.required_closure: add collectors for the LiveView (`live`) and socket/channel surfaces if a live-route or websocket boundary lane is opened; `pipe_through` references a pipeline, not a route, and stays evidence-only

open_gaps.reason: Only Req (`Req.get("url")`) ships in v2.8.0; Tesla (client + middleware base URL), HTTPoison (`HTTPoison.get("url")`), Finch (`Finch.build(:get, "url")`), and the Erlang `:httpc` stdlib each need their own detection shape and fixture.
open_gaps.required_closure: add per-library client collectors emitting http.client_request.v1 for Tesla, HTTPoison, Finch, and :httpc, each fixture-backed

open_gaps.reason: A `scope` prefix declared in another router module (or via a forwarded plug's own router) is applied cross-file, so it cannot flow into a route's effective_route_template in-file; route_template is therefore not guaranteed to be the absolute public path when such a prefix applies.
open_gaps.required_closure: resolve cross-file scope/forward prefixes, which is Miller's join responsibility per decision 0004; the extractor emits phoenix.forward.v1 only for same-file forwards

capability_gaps.reason: Lua is a dynamically typed language with no static type annotations in core syntax. Luau-style annotations are out of scope for the base Lua extractor.
capability_gaps.required_closure: Out of scope — Lua is dynamic. Luau-style type annotations would be a separate language target.

capability_gaps.reason: R is a dynamically typed language with no static type system. roxygen @param type tags are documentation-only and not currently extracted as TypeInfo.
capability_gaps.required_closure: N/A — domain limitation. Future work could harvest roxygen type annotations into TypeInfo.

capability_gaps.reason: Razor cross-file references resolve through the embedded C# pipeline, not Razor’s own pending path. Locked by razor_pending_relationships_handled_by_csharp_embed test (Phase 4b.razor).
capability_gaps.required_closure: N/A — domain classification. Locking test in crates/julie-extractors/src/tests/razor/cross_file_pending.rs enforces no-pending classification.

capability_gaps.reason: Regex backreferences are within-pattern only; there is no cross-file forward-reference construct in regex syntax.
Markdown links and footnote references are within-document. Cross-file links are URL/path strings, not symbol references.
Markdown is a presentation format with no static type system.
Markdown headings, links, and frontmatter are modeled as symbols and relationships; the extractor emits no code identifiers.
capability_gaps.required_closure: N/A — domain limitation. Add a new symbol/relationship kind before treating markdown text as identifiers.

capability_gaps.reason: JSON has no static type system. JSON Schema type keywords are runtime hints, not extracted as TypeInfo. Domain limitation, not a gap.
capability_gaps.required_closure: N/A — domain limitation. JSON Schema type extraction would require a schema-aware extractor mode outside the tree-sitter scope.

capability_gaps.reason: JSON object keys are modeled as symbols and relationships; the extractor emits no code identifiers.
capability_gaps.required_closure: N/A — domain limitation. JSON Schema-aware identifier output would require a separate schema mode.

capability_gaps.reason: TOML has no cross-document construct that requires deferred resolution. All references in TOML are file-local (Cargo deps, pyproject tool tables). Domain limitation, not a gap.
capability_gaps.required_closure: N/A — domain limitation. TOML resolution is always intra-file.

capability_gaps.reason: TOML has no static type system. Value types (string/int/array) are format-level, not extracted as TypeInfo. Domain limitation, not a gap.
TOML tables and keys are modeled as symbols and relationships; the extractor emits no code identifiers.
capability_gaps.required_closure: N/A — domain limitation. TOML key references remain symbol/relationship data.

capability_gaps.reason: YAML anchors/aliases are within-document. YAML has no cross-document forward-reference construct.
YAML has no static type system. Tag types (!!str, !!int) are format-level, not extracted as TypeInfo.
